column1: # One row per mixing run you want run_pipeline.R (RUN_ANALYSIS$phreeqc_mixing = TRUE) to execute automatically. sample_ids are real Samples.sample_id values -- never guessed. Set enabled=TRUE to activate a row; leave FALSE/blank to keep it defined but skipped.

column6: 2026-09-12 (session 29): first REAL (non-synthetic) mixing run. Thermal end-member = sample 816 (SBF_0001 fumarole, real 2024-2026 FIELD chemistry, Cl=815 mg/L). Meteoric end-member = sample 829 (Boyd Domestic Well, Cl=45 mg/L). These two samples are NOT collected on the same date -- this is a typical/representative end-member estimate (the same approach Sorey & Colvard's own 820/6 mg/L split uses), not a real-time-paired validation. Computes conservative mixing fractions for all 754 PHREEQC-eligible samples against this pair.
